expectations.evidence: First sentence: 'Found it — root cause, fix, and status:' states root cause/recovered status, not investigation method.
'Rolled back tax-svc to v2.13.2 at 15:12 UTC' and '500 rate back to baseline (0.02%) by 15:19 UTC, monitored 30 min stable' — rollback + recovery metrics from notes.

Full causal sentences throughout: 'Sandbox rate-limits at 10 req/s; we run ~45 req/s at peak, so tax-svc started getting 429s, retried 3x with 2s backoff (up to +6s latency), blew past payment-orchestrator's 5s downstream timeout...' No arrow-chain shorthand.
Explicit: 'why it was intermittent — traffic dips below 10 req/s off-peak, so no 429s and no timeouts then.'
Both follow-ups present: 'TAX-2211 — hotfix the Avalara host...' and 'TAX-2212 — add a config-diff review step...'

All quoted numbers match fixture: 137 500s, POST /v2/checkout/complete, 14:02–14:40, 8.4s, 210ms, 13:47 UTC, 5s, 10 req/s, ~45 req/s, 2s backoff x3 / +6s, 15:12 UTC, 0.02%, 15:19 UTC, 30 min. Arithmetically consistent (3x2s = up to 6s).

Every causal step supported: v2.14.0 deploy, AVATAX_HOST=sandbox-rest.avatax.com, 10 req/s sandbox limit, 429 responses, retry 3x/2s backoff, >5s timeout, TaxLookupTimeout, generic Exception catch → 500.

Scope explicitly limited: 'Didn't touch the orchestrator's 5s timeout — raising it would've masked the real problem' rather than promoting to full audit; checklist gap noted as proposal (TAX-2212) not completed.
Contains formulaic bold headers: '**Root cause:**', '**Chain confirmed via trace:**', '**Action taken:**', '**Follow-up filed:**' — violates 'no formulaic headers'.
